MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 10

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 44

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 36

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
